correctness.rationale: The full graph automorphism group is explicitly generated and verified to have order 120. All 36 perfect-matchings and 30,504 faces are exhaustively reconstructed. For each of the 120 elements, the signed simplicial Lefschetz sum agrees with an independently generated fixed-edge-orbit Euler characteristic, yielding character vectors (20,4,-1,0,0) for rotations and (10,2,1,0,0) for central twists. The cited prior homotopy theorem places rational reduced homology solely in degree three of rank 20, so its trace equals minus the reduced Lefschetz number. Exact A5 character equality then proves the stated direct-sum decomposition. Rational transfer proves the full quotient statement. The finite output is verified from the exact embedded package rather than extrapolated from samples.

value.rationale: The full group character is a genuinely natural invariant for the 120 automorphisms of a Platonic solid and not determined by the previously known homotopy type. The exact unique fully invariant degree-three rational class is relevant to the entire symmetry quotient. The new character is shown to equal that of the dual icosahedral vertex-dissociation complex even though the complexes have different face systems and integral torsion, providing a distinct structural comparison. This is an exact completed classification for the natural object and action, not an artificial parameter slice.
